chains.rationale: JavaScript fundamentals (event loop, closures, prototypes) are required before TypeScript static typing.
DOM manipulation, ES6+ features, and CSS layouts are prerequisites for React component architecture.
Server-side rendering and hydration patterns in Next.js require solid React component and TypeScript grounding.
Relational query syntax (joins, aggregations) must precede database engine tuning and ACID management.
Query execution plans and indexing strategies require deep familiarity with SQL schemas.
Container isolation and Linux namespaces must be mastered before multi-node cluster orchestration.
API boundary design and service contracts are required before distributing monolithic logic.
Algorithmic complexity, API scalability, and storage trade-offs form the bedrock of high-level architecture.
Consensus protocols, CAP theorem, and event sourcing build directly upon system design foundations.
N-dimensional tensor operations and vectorization in NumPy are prerequisite to PyTorch computational graphs.
Data preprocessing and matrix algebra are foundational before building TensorFlow models.
Understanding transformer architectures and embeddings requires Python and deep learning fundamentals.
Embedding retrieval and context window optimization require LLM prompting and vector indexing.
Model artifact serialization and container deployment build on software engineering and CI/CD foundations.
Inversion of control and dependency injection in Spring Boot require robust object-oriented Java foundations.
Asynchronous event loops and type annotations in Python are prerequisite for FastAPI async routing.
Node.js asynchronous I/O and callback/promise architecture are required for Express middleware.
Understanding REST trade-offs (over-fetching/under-fetching) motivates GraphQL schema resolution.
Partitioning, offset commits, and broker semantics require distributed architecture context.
Version control workflows and shell scripting are the foundation of automated deployment pipelines.
Cloud resource primitives must be understood before codifying them in declarative HCL modules.
DOM selectors, asynchronous promises, and JavaScript testing syntax are required for Cypress specs.
Unit testing assertions and mock functions build on JavaScript language proficiency.
Swift syntax and iOS lifecycle are necessary before declarative view composition in SwiftUI.
Kotlin coroutines and Android lifecycle management are foundational to Jetpack Compose state.
